name: YouTube Video, Channel, Search and Comments Scraper
title: YouTube Video, Channel, Search & Comments Scraper
uses: Creators and agencies researching top videos, views and likes for a topic
Finding YouTube channels by keyword with subscribers, video counts and external links
Pulling comments and replies for sentiment and audience research
AI agents that need YouTube video, channel or comment data as JSON without an API key

inputs.name: videoUrls
inputs.title: Video URLs or IDs
inputs.description: YouTube video links (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live) or 11-character video ids. Returns full details for each.

inputs.name: channels
inputs.title: Channels
inputs.description: Channel @handles, channel URLs or UC... channel ids. Lists the latest videos from each channel.

inputs.name: maxResultsPerQuery
inputs.title: Max results per search query
inputs.description: Top results per query, in YouTube order.

inputs.name: uploadedWithin
inputs.title: Search: uploaded within
inputs.description: Only videos uploaded within this window.

inputs.name: playlistUrls
inputs.title: Playlist URLs
inputs.description: Public playlist links or playlist ids.

inputs.name: fullDetails
inputs.title: Full details for listed videos
inputs.description: For channel, search and playlist results, also fetch likes, comment count, exact publish date, tags, category, description and chapters. Turn off for faster, lighter rows. Same price either way.

inputs.name: maxTotalResults
inputs.title: Max total videos (0 = no limit)
inputs.description: Hard cap on charged rows for the whole run.

inputs.name: channelSearchQueries
inputs.title: Channel search keywords
inputs.description: Keywords to find matching YouTube channels (like YouTube search filtered to Channels). Each result is one channel row with channel id, name, @handle, URL, subscriber count, video count, description, avatar, verified flag and external links.

inputs.name: maxChannelsPerQuery
inputs.title: Max channels per keyword
inputs.description: Channels returned per keyword, in YouTube order.

inputs.name: channelSearchDetails
inputs.title: Channel details (video count, full description)
inputs.description: Also open each found channel to add its video count, full description and keywords. Same price either way.

inputs.name: channelSearchAbout
inputs.title: Channel About page (links, country, total views)
inputs.description: Also read each found channel's About panel to add external links (website, Instagram, X and others), country, joined date and total channel views. Same price either way. Needs Channel details on.

inputs.name: commentVideoUrls
inputs.title: Videos to scrape comments from
inputs.description: YouTube video or Shorts URLs (or 11-character ids). Returns top comments with text, author, likes, reply count, hearted flag and comment link.

inputs.name: maxCommentsPerVideo
inputs.title: Max top-level comments per video
inputs.description: Comments are returned in YouTube top-comments order.

inputs.name: maxRepliesPerComment
inputs.title: Max replies per comment
inputs.description: 0 skips replies. Replies are returned as rows with type reply and parentCommentId.

description: YouTube data in one actor: video details, channel videos, shorts, keyword search, channel search by keyword, playlists and comments. Views, likes, publish date, tags, subscribers, channel video counts. $0.30/1K videos, $2/1K channels. No API key, no proxy.
